tool.name: CutAdapt
tool.description: Trim and discard reads and read sections.
tool.command:
## Cutadapt chooses the output writer by file name, not by Galaxy ## datatype. ln -s '$input_files.query' 'input.fastq' &&
cutadapt --cores \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if $read_modification_options.cut_five_prime --cut $read_modification_options.cut_five_prime #end if #if $read_modification_options.cut_three_prime --cut -$read_modification_options.cut_three_prime #end if #if $read_modification_options.length --length $read_modification_options.length #end if #if $filter_options.minimum_length --minimum-length $filter_options.minimum_length #end if #if $filter_options.maximum_length --maximum-length $filter_options.maximum_length #end if #if $filter_options.max_n --max-n $filter_options.max_n #end if --output 'trimmed.fastq' 'input.fastq'

param.name: query
param.label: FASTQ file
param.help: Reads to trim. Select a list collection to trim every file in it

param.name: cut_five_prime
param.label: Trim bases at the 5' end
param.help: Remove this number of bases from the start of every read [--cut]

param.name: cut_three_prime
param.label: Trim bases at the 3' end
param.help: Remove this number of bases from the end of every read [--cut -N]

param.name: length
param.label: Shorten reads to LENGTH
param.help: Shorten every read to this length by removing bases from the 3' end, after the trimming above [--length]

param.name: minimum_length
param.label: Minimum length
param.help: Discard reads shorter than this length after trimming [--minimum-length]

param.name: maximum_length
param.label: Maximum length
param.help: Discard reads longer than this length after trimming [--maximum-length]

param.name: max_n
param.label: Maximum N's
param.help: Discard reads with more than COUNT 'N' bases. If COUNT is a number between 0 and 1, it is interpreted as a fraction of the read length [--max-n]

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark See CutAdapt documentation: https://cutadapt.readthedocs.io/en/stable/guide.html for full software details.
**What it does** Trims a fixed number of bases from the 5' and 3' ends of every read, shortens reads to a set length, and discards reads that are too short, too long or have too many N bases. Leave an option empty to skip it.
Select a list collection to trim every file in it. Galaxy runs the tool once for every file and returns a list of trimmed files.
